lines.text: Only about three percent of adults have clear, written goals. At least, that's what Brian Tracy writes in Eat That Frog.
Because a goal that only lives in your head... is just a wish.
It has no energy behind it. It leads to confusion, vagueness, and mistakes.
So write it down. Think on paper. Turn it into something you can touch and see.
Try this today. Write down ten goals. Then pick the one that would change your life the most.
Write it down. And make it real.
